note: LEVEL-DESIGN-SPEC.md 6.3. Every leaf is {value, source, confidence}. confidence is measured | derived | guess. A null value means 'not known yet', and code that needs it must refuse rather than assume. Replaced by scripts/calibrate.py (M2).

tick_rate.source: S-L3, scripts/check_replay.py 2026-11-07: processCommands runs 240/s with a fixed 1/240 s step

ground_top_y.source: S-L1, scripts/check_m0_fixes.py 2026-11-07: a default block resting on the ground reads y = 15 (save key 3 = protocol y after the M0 sign fix), so the ground top is 0. One level so far; the spec's three-level check (incl. a raised start position) is still open.

landing_tolerance.source: simulator golden fit 2026-11-07 (every P4/P5 run reproduces for 5 to 12 units), narrowed by playtest 2026-11-09 (slot 10: the game landed feet 8.72 below a top), so 8.72 to 12; 10.5 is the middle

inner_hitbox.source: simulator golden fit, 2026-11-07: every P4/P5 run reproduces for an inner half-width of 3.8 to 5.0 (P4 alone bounds it to 3.72..5.02); 9 (half 4.5) is the middle. P10/P11 2026-11-09: side hits from a start position agree with 4.5 or come one tick later in the game (identical runs differ: B runs 29-45), never earlier.

terminal_velocity.source: playtest 2026-11-09, slot 10: falling vy stops at -15.0 at 1x and stays there until landing; the upward cap is not measured

air_press_buffered.source: scripts/calibrate.py P6, 2026-11-07: a press made in the air before reaching the orb, still held, fires on the first overlapping tick (pressed 160, fired 172)

jump_hold_fires_orb.source: scripts/calibrate.py P6, 2026-11-07: holding the press that made the ground jump does not fire the orb (no impulse in the orb window; the next one is the re-jump on landing)

fire_delay_ticks.source: scripts/calibrate.py P6, 2026-11-07: a press at tick N while overlapping fires on tick N+1 (every sweep run)

outer_hitbox.source: calibrate.py P5, 2026-11-07: running into a spike (hitbox x 252..258) dies at player x 237.58 (right edge 252.58) and not at 236.28 (251.28): half-width 15
